pattern: you may reveal up to {n:Qty} {f:CardsDesc} from among {g:Seen} and put the revealed cards into your hand
subject: none

examples.text: When ~ enters, look at the top six cards of your library. You may reveal up to two artifact cards from among them and put the revealed cards into your hand. Put the rest on the bottom of your library in a random order.
Look at the top four cards of your library. You may reveal up to three land cards from among them and put the revealed cards into your hand. Put the rest into your graveyard.
